turns.prompt: Replace Thursday with a swim, but I have no pool or open-water access all week. Prepare a 30-minute swim Thursday 6:30 PM.
turns.text:
I can’t prepare a swim without pool or open-water access. The calendar should reflect an activity you can actually do.

Would you like to choose a feasible Thursday replacement instead—such as keeping the steady run, making it an easy run, or taking a rest day?
